Maya (Sales): Heads-up: customer needs PO plus signed order form today. procurement insists on e-sign certificate fingerprint + envelope audit trail. They also requested Net30 EOM and a billing contact. Can legal/finance confirm we accept DocuSign artifacts as evidence of authorization?
Liam (Finance): Net30 EOM okay. Need billing contact and tax ID. We'll email invoice unless they insist on portal. Note: revenue can't be recognized until signed order + MSA are in S3.
Hana (Legal): We accept DocuSign audit trail + certificate thumbprint as sufficient authorization in most vendor checks. If they want wet-ink or bank letter, we escalate. I'll draft a one-liner clause: "e-sign envelope audit trail and signing certificate suffice as proof of authorization."
Omar (Procurement Ops): Procurement asks for cert chain details (issuer, serial, thumbprint) plus envelope pdf. Also prefer a signed attestation: "Signed by authorized procurement officer." If we include that as a cover page in DocuSign, it'll speed onboarding.
Guillermo (Eng): No technical issues. If they ask about HSM for key storage, we can provide SOC2 summary, but not private key details. For private infra offers, we can share additional CA info under NDA.
docusign-bot: Envelope DEF-2024-11 created by maya@redwood.ai. status: pending signature. https://app.docusign.com/envelope/DEF-2024-11
Maya (Sales): Plan: Hana will create the clause and a one-page redline summary, Liam will confirm billing details, Omar will confirm exact cert fields needed, and I'll prepare the envelope with PO `PO-99123`. Target sign by EOD.
Liam (Finance): Billing: `ap@clientco.com`, tax ID `77-1234567`. Invoice via email.
Omar (Procurement Ops): They only need: issuer, thumbprint, serial, timestamp, and full envelope audit trail pdf. If included, vendor team auto-approves.
Hana (Legal): Draft clause: "Authorized Signer: Execution of this Order Form by the signatory constitutes representation that they are an authorized officer or procurement representative of Customer. The Parties agree that the e-signature envelope audit trail and signing certificate (including issuer and thumbprint) constitute sufficient evidence of authorization for all purposes under this Agreement." Approving this as doc to attach.
docusign-bot: Envelope DEF-2024-11 signed by `J. Alvarez` at 2392224497  audit-trail attached. status: completed.
Maya (Sales): Signed, team — thanks. Liam will raise invoice, Hana to finish MSA redline and upload to S3, Omar to confirm vendor onboarding. I'll update the deal record.
